description: identity.rs destroy loop: id_val.as_str() returns None → continue, silently swallowing non-string array elements. mailbox.rs and submission.rs both call find(|v| !v.is_string()) and return Err(invalidArguments) for the whole request. RFC 8620 §5.3 says the destroy array is Id[] — a non-string element is a malformed request, not a per-item error. Identity/set is inconsistent and masks client bugs.
title: Identity/set silently skips non-string destroy elements
